source_of_truth: Poki Developer Guide, Game thumbnail, checked 2026-10-13. This spec covers the documented static thumbnail only; the authenticated submission form has not been inspected. The form wins when it supplies additional or changed requirements. The local thumbnail.png filename is a Studio convention, not a portal filename rule.
confirmed_by_docs: A static thumbnail is required to start the player fit test.
Deliver a full-bleed square of at least 628 by 628 pixels.
Use no padding, borders or letterboxing; Poki applies rounded corners.
Avoid text, keep the composition readable at small sizes, and show the game's actual default character or a key gameplay element.
An animated thumbnail is added during Soft Release and is required before global release; this static-thumbnail spec does not validate it.

assets.note: PNG is the Studio output convention. This guide does not establish upload MIME types, byte caps or a maximum pixel size. Visual and provenance review remain required.

undocumented: Accepted upload formats, byte caps and maximum image dimensions are not stated on the cited page; confirm in the authenticated form.
Listing text fields, language requirements, character limits and screenshot counts are not covered by this page or this spec.
Animated-thumbnail duration, dimensions and encoding are outside this static-thumbnail contract.
A passing local check proves only the declared static-thumbnail fields, not complete store readiness or portal approval.
